parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id AS indication_curie, di.mesh_heading AS indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON di.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND di.mesh_heading = 'Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer' ORDER BY md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind
